global: Long-form explainer (would a toaster still work in a freezer). Off-white canvas, black line art; red for heat lines, energy arrows, glow and labels; orange coil inside a red-glow toaster; grey for water stains, frost, a towel, the shocked grey-toned scene and the night scene (mid-grey sky, white stars, black tree silhouettes). Opening headphone presenter and whiteboard with a typed-on question card; one blurred push-in to a freezer cutaway; red series title card (animated mascot); then a freezer/toaster comparison, a temperature axis, a group of three recurring host-like figures with a fridge, a fridge-cycle COP diagram, an ice-cream-shop gag, a winter night porch sequence with wolves' eyes, a podcast-table punchline; red end card.

continuity: Recurring freezer/fridge cutaway (fan unit, ice tray, outlet, lamp) across damage states (heat lines, frost, water stains, towel, sparks, electrified grey scene); the toaster carries COP labels and a red glow that persists into the ice-cream shop and the night porch; a recurring trio of host figures with glasses/beard/hair appears in the fridge scenes and the closing podcast table; the beanie figure with toast carries from the porch to the punchline. Replace the series mascot, title card, end card, books and credits; replace the real podcast name on the question card with an invented source, and give the trio of hosts original designs that do not caricature real people.
